Messages.Author: John Woods
Messages.Body:
1) If I use the Obtenebration strike card Entombment at superior where it
sends a vampire to topor, can that be dodged?

2) Does the vampire go immediately to torpor and combat ends (like a
Strike:Combat Ends) or is that vampire still able to dish out damage before
going to torpor during damage resolution? I guess the short form of the
question is... does Entombment resolve immediately or during strike
resolution?

3) Since the Giovanni are an Independant clan, are any of them able to
become the Prince of Venice (or any other prince for that matter)? My guess
is no, but I would think that Venice might be an unusual case (since all
Giovanni get an extra vote for that city's praxis seizure).

Thanks.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <W73e6.92765$3j.58...@news1.gvcl1.bc.home.com>,

"John Woods" <jo...@pacificcoast.net> wrote:
> 1) If I use the Obtenebration strike card Entombment
> at superior where it sends a vampire to topor, can that be dodged?

Yes.
All strikes except Scorpion Sting at Superior can be dodged.
Note that dodging only negates the strikes effect on you,
it doesn't prevent the strike from happening.

> 2) Does the vampire go immediately to torpor and combat ends (like a
> Strike:Combat Ends) or is that vampire still able to dish out damage
> before going to torpor during damage resolution?
> I guess the short form of the question is... does Entombment resolve
> immediately or during strike resolution?

Entombment resolves during strike resolution like all other strikes
that are not Strike: Combat Ends, Dodge, or First Strike.

> 3) Since the Giovanni are an Independant clan, are any of them able to
> become the Prince of Venice (or any other prince for that matter)?

No.
Not without a Giovanni Acceptance passing or Writ of Acceptance.

> My guess is no, but I would think that Venice might be an unusual
> case (since all Giovanni get an extra vote for that city's praxis
> seizure).

A vampire must be a member of the Camarilla to be a Prince.
If the Giovanni that you want to be Prince of Venice is not
a member of the Camarilla, he cannot become the Prince.

> Thanks.

Your welcome.
